rule: Each record is a literal slice of the derived text: the fixture line, its venue, the weekday and the "TO TIME" cell, under the GROUP ROUND 6 heading whose column is labelled (CET). CET = UTC+1, so 18:45h CET = 17:45Z and 20:45h CET = 19:45Z. scripts/apply_evidence.py re-derives every slice from the committed bytes and refuses the record if any slice does not match.

excluded.reason: Source conflict, so no release record is written: the EHF group-phase PDF prints "FC Porto vs One Veszprém HC … 28.10.2026 20:45h" (20:45 CET = 19:45Z) while OLBG prints 17:45 and the EHF match-centre page text captured at 2026-10-26T20:24Z no longer renders a clock at all. A prior session recorded 18:45 CET from that page on 2026-10-23. The three disagree, so the row is held rather than certified.
